title: What Is Inguinal Hernia Surgery?
description: What inguinal hernia surgery (inguinal hernioplasty) is, what it is for and when it is indicated. Care in Lima with price alternatives.
tldr: Inguinal hernia surgery repairs the defect in the abdominal wall at the groin through which tissue protrudes. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
Inguinal hernia surgery repairs the defect in the abdominal wall at the groin through which tissue protrudes.

How is it done?

It is repaired with mesh, using an open or laparoscopic approach, reinforcing the wall.

When is it indicated?

People with a symptomatic inguinal hernia or one at risk of becoming trapped. The surgeon decides.
